scope: Historical settings for the three completed repeat runs used in the v3 article. No current live defaults have been substituted.

source_checkpoint.note: BF16 input to the published quantization; not a revision or checksum of the serving artifact.

slonik.request_evidence: Retained provider configuration and a retained serialized model request from this completed run.
slonik.reasoning_observation: Structured thinking blocks exist in the saved session.

qwen.request_evidence: Historical run audit and retained generation telemetry. A full serialized request/provider snapshot was not retained in the reviewed package.
qwen.reasoning_observation: No thinking blocks were found in the reviewed sample of early responses; this is not an inspection of every response.

glm.request_evidence: Retained provider configuration and a retained serialized model request from this completed run. Sampling parameters are absent from that request.
glm.reasoning_observation: Structured thinking blocks exist in the saved session.

harness.name: Markov, the internal Postgres Professional coding agent
harness.publicly_reproducible_scope: The patches and their independent PostgreSQL checks can be reproduced without Markov. The original agent runs require the internal agent and its provider integration.
harness.tool: One supplied shell tool operating on the isolated source and persistent build directories.
harness.approval_policy: Automatic approval for valid calls to the supplied isolated shell.
harness.system_instruction: Use only the supplied isolated shell. Follow PostgreSQL C style. Do not delegate or commit.

accounting.model_responses: Completed oMLX responses for the task, excluding one startup probe.
accounting.input_tokens: Includes cached prefixes and context sent again on later calls.
accounting.output_tokens: Combined output; the collected data has no separate reasoning-token counter.
accounting.markov_seconds: Whole agent session, including commands, with model loading and independent validation measured separately.

limits: The context and output limits are recorded historical configuration values; they are not estimates inferred from the largest response.
Slonik thinking_budget=192 is a sent request parameter. Its enforcement by the model server was not independently verified.
The exact immutable revisions/checksums of the three serving artifacts were not captured in the reviewed run evidence.

Unlisted sampling parameters, random seeds, the exact inference-server build and effective Lightning MTP enablement were not established for these runs. The mtp suffix alone does not prove that MTP was enabled.
The models used different thinking, context and output settings. These single runs do not isolate model quality or the effect of fine-tuning.
